english.title: Accept consideration from consumer before end of withdrawal period
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) accepted consideration from a consumer, namely **(..SPECIFY THE CONSUMER..),in relation to

(A)_[a timeshare]_
(B)_[a long-term holiday product]_
(C)_[an exchange]_

contract before the end of the withdrawal period
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 25(3) and (7) and 27 of the Timeshare, Holiday Products, Resale and Exchange Contracts Regulations 2010.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum
Indictment: A fine

Time Limit on Prosecutions;
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
